description:
Location: Fully remote – Europe (CET ±3 hours)
Salary: €75,000–€105,000/year, depending on location and experience
Contract: B2B preferred, flexible
Experience: 5+ years
Important: Must be comfortable working with explicit NSFW content.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer to join a fast-growing AI technology company behind an AI companionship platform used by millions worldwide.

You’ll work on scalable, AI-powered applications, developing new features and improving existing functionality alongside the CTO, Tech Lead and wider engineering team.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys coding, taking ownership and delivering high-quality solutions in a fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable backend applications using Ruby on Rails.

  • Build new features and improve existing platform functionality.

  • Work with Product Managers to translate requirements into technical solutions and estimate development efforts.

  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested production code.

  • Participate in code reviews, testing and technical decision-making.

  • Troubleshoot issues and improve application performance, reliability and scalability.

  • Collaborate with distributed engineering, product and infrastructure teams.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of commercial experience in backend or full-stack software engineering.

  • Strong, hands-on Ruby on Rails experience, ideally recent and in production.

  • Experience building and scaling production applications with real users.

  • Ability to take ownership of features from requirements through development, testing and deployment.

  • Previous experience in a startup, scale-up or similarly fast-paced environment.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to balance code quality with delivery speed.

  • Excellent English and experience working with international teams.

  • Full comfort working with uncensored AI companionship products and explicit NSFW content.

Tech Stack

Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Redis, Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus) and Tailwind CSS.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with generative AI, LLMs, NLP or machine learning.

  • Familiarity with modern Rails development practices and AI-assisted coding tools.

  • Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams.

What’s on Offer?

  • 100% remote working.

  • Competitive salary, depending on location and experience.

  • Direct collaboration with senior engineering leadership.

  • Opportunity to influence technical decisions and product development.

  • 20 days of paid annual leave.

  • Learning and development budget, health and wellbeing support.

  • Company laptop and equipment.

  • Access to AI development tools, including Cursor, Claude Code and ChatGPT.

  • Annual company gathering.
